description: Defines a template class QhullLinkedList for a linked list data structure with STL and Qt compatibility, including nested iterator classes and utility functions.

classes.name: QhullLinkedList
classes.description: A template linked list class with STL and Qt iterator support, managing opaque type T with sentinel end node.

classes.name: QhullLinkedList::const_iterator
classes.description: Const version of STL-style iterator for QhullLinkedList.

classes.name: QhullLinkedListIterator
classes.description: Java-style iterator for QhullLinkedList, supporting forward and backward traversal.
